title: On the formal definition of average function for interval data
summary: This paper addresses the formal definition of average functions for interval data, extending classical aggregation theory beyond precise numerical values to the more general setting of real-valued intervals. Recognizing that interval data nat- urally arise in contexts involving imprecision or uncertainty, we examine how established notions of averages and aggregation functions can be generalized when the underlying domain is no longer restricted to the unit interval, but instead encompasses the entire real line.
